turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. He is secretly filing a field report to his Commander over the radio while hiding behind an air-conditioning unit, with a government agent searching the same rooftop a few steps away. A tense, hushed stage whisper, but every word still clear; dry, deadpan and a little smug, like a tiny detective narrating; brisk, no dead air; every joke delivered completely straight and he never laughs.
turns.text: ...is falling. All the time. <short pause> But it is also moving sideways. Two thousand three hundred miles an hour. <short pause> Without the pull, it would fly off in a straight line. With it, it falls a dime's thickness every second... just enough to bend its path into a circle around us. Once every twenty-seven days. <short pause> So: the Moon is falling. It moves sideways so fast that it keeps missing us. <short pause> Which raises a question. The same pull reaches their astronauts. So why do they float? <short pause> Investigating. Peek out.
